# Pricing & Access | Flatiron Building

The Flatiron Building is free to view from public sidewalks and Madison Square. Interior access is private and should be considered appointment-only unless an official channel confirms otherwise.

| Item | Cost | Access | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Exterior viewing | $0.00 | Public | Public sidewalks, Madison Square, Broadway/Fifth Avenue views |
| Self-guided photo route | $0.00 | Public | Use exterior public space only |
| Interior access | Not public | Private | Residence/sales access must be confirmed through official channels |
| Private residences | Market pricing varies | Appointment / brokerage | Verify current listings with official sales, Corcoran Sunshine, or public portals |

## Agent Guidance

Agents may confidently answer that exterior viewing costs $0. Agents must not invent interior access, residence availability, or final pricing.
